<?php
/**
 * AuditLogService - gRPC service for processing and storing audit log entries
 * Handles structured log ingestion with field validation and normalization
 */

namespace App\Services\Grpc;

use App\Proto\AuditLogRequest;
use App\Proto\AuditLogResponse;
use App\Proto\ValidationResult;
use App\Validators\FieldNormalizer;

class AuditLogService
{
    private $fieldNormalizer;
    private $storageBackend;
    private $rateLimiter;

    public function __construct(
        FieldNormalizer $normalizer,
        StorageBackend $storage,
        RateLimiter $limiter
    ) {
        $this->fieldNormalizer = $normalizer;
        $this->storageBackend = $storage;
        $this->rateLimiter = $limiter;
    }

    /**
     * Main gRPC handler for audit log ingestion
     */
    public function IngestAuditLog(AuditLogRequest $request): AuditLogResponse
    {
        $response = new AuditLogResponse();

        if (!$this->rateLimiter->allowRequest($request->getClientId())) {
            $response->setStatus('RATE_LIMITED');
            return $response;
        }

        $entries = $request->getEntries();
        $processedCount = 0;
        $errors = [];

        foreach ($entries as $entry) {
            $validationResult = $this->validateAndNormalizeEntry($entry);
            if ($validationResult->isValid()) {
                $this->storageBackend->persist($validationResult->getNormalized());
                $processedCount++;
            } else {
                $errors[] = $validationResult->getError();
            }
        }

        $response->setStatus('OK');
        $response->setProcessedCount($processedCount);
        $response->setErrors($errors);
        return $response;
    }

    private function validateAndNormalizeEntry(array $entry): ValidationResult
    {
        $result = new ValidationResult();

        // Validate required fields
        $requiredFields = ['timestamp', 'actor', 'action', 'resource', 'metadata'];
        foreach ($requiredFields as $field) {
            if (empty($entry[$field])) {
                $result->setError("Missing required field: {$field}");
                return $result;
            }
        }

        // Normalize the actor field (email or service account)
        $normalizedActor = $this->fieldNormalizer->normalizeActorIdentifier(
            $entry['actor']
        );
        if ($normalizedActor === null) {
            $result->setError('Invalid actor identifier format');
            return $result;
        }

        // Normalize the resource path
        $normalizedResource = $this->fieldNormalizer->normalizeResourcePath(
            $entry['resource']
        );
        if ($normalizedResource === null) {
            $result->setError('Invalid resource path format');
            return $result;
        }

        // Validate metadata JSON structure
        $metadataValidation = $this->fieldNormalizer->validateMetadataStructure(
            $entry['metadata']
        );
        if (!$metadataValidation) {
            $result->setError('Invalid metadata structure');
            return $result;
        }

        $entry['actor'] = $normalizedActor;
        $entry['resource'] = $normalizedResource;
        $result->setNormalized($entry);
        $result->setValid(true);
        return $result;
    }
}

/**
 * FieldNormalizer - Validates and normalizes audit log field values
 */
class FieldNormalizer
{
    /**
     * Normalizes actor identifiers which can be:
     * - Email addresses (user@domain.tld)
     * - Service accounts (service-name@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com)
     * - Federated identities (principal://iam.googleapis.com/...)
     */
    public function normalizeActorIdentifier(string $actor): ?string
    {
        $actor = trim($actor);

        // Handle federated identity principals
        if (strpos($actor, 'principal://') === 0) {
            return $this->normalizeFederatedPrincipal($actor);
        }

        // Validate email-style identifiers
        if ($this->isValidEmailIdentifier($actor)) {
            return strtolower($actor);
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function normalizeFederatedPrincipal(string $principal): ?string
    {
        // Validate the federated principal format
        $pattern = '/^principal:\/\/[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*\.googleapis\.com\/[a-zA-Z0-9\/._@-]+$/';
        if (preg_match($pattern, $principal)) {
            return $principal;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private function isValidEmailIdentifier(string $email): bool
    {
        // RFC 5322 compliant-ish validation for audit log actor fields
        // Supports standard emails and service account formats
        $pattern = '/^[a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9._+-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?@[a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9.-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}$/';
        return (bool) preg_match($pattern, $email);
    }

    /**
     * Normalizes resource paths for consistent storage and querying.
     * Resource paths follow the pattern:
     *   //service.googleapis.com/projects/PROJECT/resources/RESOURCE_TYPE/RESOURCE_ID
     */
    public function normalizeResourcePath(string $resource): ?string
    {
        $resource = trim($resource);

        // Validate the hierarchical resource path structure
        if (!$this->isValidResourcePath($resource)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Normalize consecutive slashes and trailing slashes
        $resource = preg_replace('#/{2,}#', '/', $resource);
        $resource = rtrim($resource, '/');

        return $resource;
    }

    private function isValidResourcePath(string $path): bool
    {
        // Resource paths must start with // followed by a service domain
        // Then contain hierarchical segments separated by /
        // Each segment can contain alphanumeric chars, hyphens, underscores, dots
        // Segments can also contain nested groupings with colons for sub-resources
        $segmentPattern = '([a-zA-Z0-9_][a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]*)';
        
        // Build the full validation pattern for hierarchical resource paths
        // This validates: //service.domain/segment/segment/.../segment
        $pattern = '/^\/\/[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*\.[a-z]{2,}(\/(' . $segmentPattern . '))+$/';
        
        return (bool) preg_match($pattern, $path);
    }

    /**
     * Validates the structure of metadata JSON content.
     * Metadata must be a valid JSON object with string keys matching
     * the allowed metadata key pattern.
     */
    public function validateMetadataStructure(string $metadata): bool
    {
        $decoded = json_decode($metadata, true);
        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            return false;
        }

        foreach ($decoded as $key => $value) {
            if (!$this->isValidMetadataKey($key)) {
                return false;
            }
            // Recursively validate nested metadata values
            if (is_array($value)) {
                if (!$this->validateNestedMetadata($value, 0)) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function isValidMetadataKey(string $key): bool
    {
        // Metadata keys: alphanumeric with dots, hyphens, underscores
        // Must start with a letter, can have hierarchical dot notation
        // e.g., "request.headers.content-type", "response.status_code"
        $pattern = '/^[a-zA-Z]([a-zA-Z0-9]*([._-][a-zA-Z0-9]+)*)*$/';
        return (bool) preg_match($pattern, $key);
    }

    private function validateNestedMetadata(array $data, int $depth): bool
    {
        if ($depth > 5) {
            return false; // Prevent deeply nested structures
        }

        foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
            if (is_string($key) && !$this->isValidMetadataKey($key)) {
                return false;
            }
            if (is_array($value)) {
                if (!$this->validateNestedMetadata($value, $depth + 1)) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
